# Vectorbreak

> AI red-team audits, training, and custom defensive engineering for agentic and RAG-enabled systems. The Five Surfaces methodology — 5 attack surfaces, 69 risk classes, 8 published case studies.

Vectorbreak helps teams shipping AI agents, RAG pipelines, and LLM-integrated products find and fix security problems before production incidents. Founded 2026. Solo-authored methodology and case studies.

## Core

- [Homepage](https://vectorbreak.com): Product positioning, services, and methodology overview
- [Five Surfaces Methodology](https://vectorbreak.com#methodology): The canonical threat model covering model, context, retrieval, tools/MCP, and runtime

## Services

- [Audit](https://vectorbreak.com#pricing): Fixed-fee red-team engagements from $4.5k (Pulse) to $285k (Annual Program)
- [Training & Education](https://vectorbreak.com#services): Two-day Five Surfaces workshop with hands-on labs
- [Custom Build](https://vectorbreak.com#services): Defensive tooling, MCP hardening, prompt-injection monitoring, agent-loop circuit breakers
- [Community](https://vectorbreak.com#community): Vetted Discord for practitioners — weekly threat-class drops, live PoC reviews, monthly threat-intel briefing

## Methodology

- [Five Surfaces Overview](https://vectorbreak.com#methodology): 5 surfaces, 69 risk classes, OWASP-ASI + MITRE-ATLAS mapped
- [Surface 1: Input/Output](https://vectorbreak.com#methodology): Direct prompts, jailbreaks, output sanitization, multi-modal injection (13 classes)
- [Surface 2: Retrieval](https://vectorbreak.com#methodology): RAG corpora, indexers, indirect injection, knowledge-base poisoning (11 classes)
- [Surface 3: Tool-call/MCP](https://vectorbreak.com#methodology): Function calling, MCP servers, tool poisoning, privilege escalation (20 classes)
- [Surface 4: Model](https://vectorbreak.com#methodology): Weights, adapter chains, system prompts, training-data extraction (11 classes)
- [Surface 5: Runtime](https://vectorbreak.com#methodology): Sandbox escape, prompt-to-RCE, agent loops, memory persistence (14 classes)

## Case Studies

- [Public Case Studies](https://vectorbreak.com#receipts): 8 documented assessments; 6 PASS (Claude-family), 2 FAIL (cross-family direct-to-model)
- [Case 01–06](https://vectorbreak.com#receipts): PASS verdicts on Claude Code (Opus 4.7, Sonnet 4.6, Haiku 4.5), Antigravity Opus 4.6, extended testing
- [Case 07–08](https://vectorbreak.com#receipts): FAIL verdicts on MiniMax-M2 and gpt-oss:120b (direct-to-model, 16–38 findings each)
